build_intermediate_data: build intermediate data by generating ccd.pickle and chemical_component_sets.pickle from components.cif
run_build_data: run the build_data function to generate pickle files from the libcifpp components.cif file
generate_ccd_pickle: generate a ccd.pickle file from components.cif using the ccd_pickle_gen module
generate_chemical_component_sets: generate chemical_component_sets.pickle from the ccd data using chemical_component_sets_gen
locate_components_cif: locate components.cif via LIBCIFPP_DATA_DIR env var or standard site packages path
